enabled.name: Enable flight recorder
enabled.hint: Master switch (GM). Nothing is recorded unless a session is started AND each participant opts in.

mode.name: Collection mode
mode.hint: normal: low overhead. detailed: generic clicks, focus, warnings, layer changes. diagnostic: everything (also auto-enabled for 60 s after an error, freeze or friction marker).

includeNames.name: Record entity names
includeNames.hint: Include actor/item/scene/window names (helps analysis). Off: ids and types only.

captureConsole.name: Capture console errors/warnings
captureConsole.hint: Records console.error/warn messages and their origin module.

participation.name: My participation in session recording
participation.hint: Ask: prompt when a recording starts. Yes/No: your choice for this world, kept on your account (every browser). You can change it at any time.

Key.frictionHint: Mark the current moment as confusing, difficult or broken.

Friction.title: Report friction
Friction.note: Optional note (visible to the GM's analysis)
Friction.notRecording: Flight recorder is not recording your client.

Consent.title: Session recording
Consent.body:
The GM started a session recording{label} to improve future sessions.

If you agree, your client sends to the GM's server: windows/tabs opened, buttons used, targets, token moves, rolls and their results, errors and performance measurements. Never chat text, typed text, passwords, journals, audio or screenshots. You are identified by a pseudonym. Data is used to improve the game, not to rate players.

Your choice is kept on your account: you will not be asked again. You can change it later in Configure Settings → Flight Recorder or with the REC badge.

FFR.Started: Flight recorder: this session is being recorded (your client opted in). Alt+Shift+F reports friction.

Badge.recTip: This session is recorded from your client. Click for options / report friction.
Badge.optoutTip: A session is being recorded, but not from your client.
